zh:
代尔夫特理工大学（Technische Universiteit Delft，简称 TU Delft）成立于1842年，位于荷兰南荷兰省代尔夫特市，是荷兰历史最悠久、规模最大、综合实力最强的理工大学，也是世界顶尖的理工院校之一。学校下设8个学院，覆盖航空航天、土木工程、电子电气、机械工程、建筑、应用物理、计算机科学、生物技术等工程技术领域，在校生超26000人。
代尔夫特理工大学是欧洲顶尖工科联盟 IDEA 联盟成员，在水利工程、土木工程、建筑学、航空航天工程、电子工程等领域全球领先，科研与工程实践实力突出，在全球工程界享有极高声誉。2026QS世界大学排名中，代尔夫特理工大学位列世界第47位。
en:
Delft University of Technology (Technische Universiteit Delft, TU Delft) is a public technical university located in Delft, South Holland, Netherlands. Founded in 1842, it is the oldest and largest technical university in the Netherlands and one of the world's top universities of technology. The university has 8 faculties covering aerospace engineering, civil engineering, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, architecture, applied physics, computer science, biotechnology and other engineering fields, with more than 26,000 enrolled students.
As a member of the IDEA League, TU Delft is a world leader in hydraulic engineering, civil engineering, architecture, aerospace engineering and electronic engineering. It is ranked 47th globally in the 2026 QS World University Rankings.
